source_caption:
After 24 years of defining the iconic mutant on screen, Hugh Jackman finally donned Wolverine’s classic, comic-accurate yellow and blue suit in Deadpool & Wolverine—a wildly anticipated wardrobe choice that both fans and Jackman had been desperate to see since the original X-Men in 2000. But stepping back into the role required a staggering physical transformation. At 55 years old, Jackman had recently slimmed down significantly for a massive Broadway run of The Music Man. To realistically regain his brutal, vein-popping superhero physique, he subjected himself to a grueling, months-long regimen of intense weightlifting and an absurd, punishing 6,000-calorie-a-day diet. By fiercely committing to both the physical agony and the vibrant, comic-book absurdity of the character, Jackman masterfully proves that his dedication to Logan’s legacy remains absolutely unmatched.
⠀
Deadpool & Wolverine (2024), directed by Shawn Levy, starring Ryan Reynolds, Hugh Jackman, Emma Corrin. A deeply apathetic Wade Wilson is suddenly pulled from his quiet civilian life by the Time Variance Authority, forcing him to team up with an incredibly reluctant, broken variant of Wolverine to save his entire universe from absolute annihilation.

source_details.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
source_details.synopsis: Deadpool & Wolverine is a 2024 American superhero film based on Marvel Comics featuring the characters Deadpool and Wolverine. Produced by Marvel Studios, Maximum Effort, and 21 Laps Entertainment, and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures, it is the 34th film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) and the sequel to Deadpool (2016) and Deadpool 2 (2018). The film was directed by Shawn Levy, who wrote the screenplay with Ryan Reynolds, Rhett Reese, Paul Wernick, and Zeb Wells. Reynolds and Hugh Jackman respectively star as Wade Wilson / Deadpool and Logan / Wolverine, alongside Emma Corrin, Morena Baccarin, Rob Delaney, Leslie Uggams, Aaron Stanford, and Matthew Macfadyen.
